acceptanceCriteria: Measure per-test durations for internal/tasks/store and record the top contributors.
Reduce the package's wall time well below the 30m detector (target under 10m on a quiet host) by t.Parallel, shared fixtures or splitting, without weakening any assertion.
No change to the 30m hang-detector policy unless an owner decision amends decision 0082.
body: Observed by the V1-0955 lane on 2026-10-07: a full `go test -timeout 30m ./internal/tasks/store` took 1619s on one run and timed out at 30m on another with host load average ~30 (the test running at timeout, TestCALV0087_UnchangedRepositoryNeedsNoDesignation, had run only 8s, so it is aggregate slowness, not a hang). Decision 0082 sets 30m as a per-package hang detector, so this package sits at the limit and produces false hang failures under concurrent lanes. Related archived V1-0724 (load sensitivity).
title: tests: internal/tasks/store package takes 27-30+ minutes and trips the 30m hang detector under load
